name: In-Flight Half Ginger Ale & Half Still Water (De-Gas Dilution Hack)
whyItWorks: Full-strength airplane canned sodas are super-carbonated and expand aggressively in pressurized cabins. Asking the flight attendant for half cup ginger ale and half cup bottled water cuts carbonation by 50% while retaining soothing ginger sweetness and anti-nausea benefits.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the flight attendant: 'Could I please have half a cup of ginger ale topped off with bottled spring water?' Stir lightly with your straw to disperse bubbles.
